Reviewed the public approval API: IDs are opaque and scoped by full RunKey/tool; approvalPlan recovers existing tool-bound identities without rewriting records or renewing deadlines. The optional approvalSettled callback receives detached committed state, including restored decisions, and grants no tool entry. The existing opaque-ID schema is unchanged, so this adds no writer-format migration.
